records.text: The 2022 World Cup match between Brazil and Croatia drew 6.1 million concurrent YouTube viewers.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: And when people streamed it, ... it looks like the 2022 World Cup comes into the second spot Brazil versus Croatia when it was streamed on YouTube, ... 6.1 million people tuned in again.

verification.notes: Streaming analytics records 6.1 million peak viewers on Casimito's YouTube channel for Brazil-Croatia. FIFA separately reported a larger 6.9 million cross-platform peak for partner streams, so the 6.1 million statement is accurate as a YouTube-channel figure.

records.text: Erika Frantzve says she lived in Chongqing, China, as well as Puerto Rico, and had traveled to Romania and Croatia.
records.speaker: Erika Kirk

appearances.snippet: I've lived in China. I've lived in Chongqing. I've been to Romania. I've been in Croatia. Lived in Puerto Rico for a little bit. Really handsome.

verification.notes: The audition recording directly documents that Erika said she had lived in Chongqing and Puerto Rico and visited Romania and Croatia. Romania travel is independently corroborated, and her then-boyfriend's China and Puerto Rico teams provide context, but reliable records do not establish every claimed residence and trip.

records.text: Owens said Kathryn Bolkovac's book reported that trafficked underage women came from Ukraine, Croatia, Bosnia, and Romania.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: And I want to be clear because I downloaded her book over this past weekend and was speed reading through it that the trafficked underage women were coming from Ukraine, Croatia, Bosnia, and of course, Romania.

verification.notes: The cited book was identified, but no accessible passage verified this exact four-country list. Independent reporting on the same investigation consistently identifies victims from Ukraine, Moldova, and Romania; it does not conclusively verify the Croatia and Bosnia portions as stated.
